copper.title: The Honest Shutdown
copper.text:
The Honest Shutdown

The current evidence has been classified. Review its outcome and caveats before continuing.

Game
Sound and reading

The beacon stays dark. You hang a clear fault notice where a hopeful guess used to be. Even the enormous gate seems relieved to receive an honest answer.

The chapter closes with the damaged path isolated and the next work written down. There will be no celebration of a repair that has not happened. There can still be a next attempt.

Skip scene

Deliberate safe shutdown: the severed conduit remains disconnected and service is unresolved. Isolation is not restoration.

Named unresolved fault: the severed conduit remains disconnected. Deliberate isolation keeps that path out of service. Recovery plan: return to safe preparation, repair or replace the damaged path, then measure again and repeat the endpoint test. This is honest unresolved service, never a restoration.

Read the encounter handover

Continue returns to safe encounter preparation in this temporary session. Preparation and inventory rewind; new clues, personal notes and hint-use history remain. Earlier measurements become stale and must be repeated.

Restore Save loads the signed-in account's one saved snapshot. It replaces this in-memory adventure and its unsaved changes; it does not retain new learning from this attempt. Review that decision before loading.

copper.title: The Steady Light
copper.text:
The Steady Light

The current evidence has been classified. Review its outcome and caveats before continuing.

Game
Sound and reading

The beacon above the Iron Threshold settles into a steady glow. For once, the enormous gate has nothing to complain about. You close the test record, leaving the observations beside the conclusion where the next engineer can find them.

Below, the Rift is still a scar in the stone. It is no longer an excuse for an outage. The Underworld has a working connection and a record of how you proved it. Beyond the gate, the Iron City keeps its own unfinished chapter.

Skip scene

Permanent restoration: the repaired route passed its physical checks and the separate endpoint service test.

Your record follows the copper route through the Warrens and Echo Cavern. The pages distinguish an intact conductor path from a powered device that merely looks busy.

You faced the Rift with your own observations and a well-used toolkit.

The main journey has a chapter of its own.

Continue returns to the safe Iron Threshold. Earlier rooms remain available. The Iron City is a future episode boundary, not a missing puzzle.

radio.title: The Borrowed Dawn
radio.text:
The Borrowed Dawn

The current evidence has been classified. Review its outcome and caveats before continuing.

Game
Sound and reading

The beacon lights, and someone has the good sense to leave the temporary-route sign standing. Dawn has arrived on borrowed equipment. It is still dawn.

You leave two lines in the handover: service restored; permanent work outstanding. The second line is not a smaller victory. It is the reason tomorrow's engineer will know what to do before the borrowed installation must go home.

Skip scene

Temporary restoration: the borrowed bypass passed its physical checks and the separate endpoint service test. A temporary dependency remains.

Temporary dependency: the tested bypass uses a borrowed installation in the protected work corridor. Limitation: this arrangement cannot be left as the permanent route. Follow-up: install and validate the permanent protected route before removing or returning the borrowed installation. Temporary service must pass the same fresh physical and endpoint checks.

Your record follows the radio route through the Skywell and Storm Observatory. Signal and noise have separate places in the notebook. Neither was allowed to make a promise about service by itself.

You faced the Rift with your own observations and a well-used toolkit.

The main journey has a chapter of its own.

The borrowed-route handover stays tucked into your notebook, its limits and follow-up plainly marked.

Continue returns to the safe Iron Threshold. The borrowed installation remains a temporary dependency; earlier rooms are still available.
